title: NCAA Football: Teams to be Top 3 in the Week 7 AP Poll
description:
This market will resolve "Yes" if the listed team is ranked within the top 3 (positions 1 through 3, inclusive) of the Week 7 Associated Press (AP) Top 25 college football poll for the 2026 season. Otherwise, this market will resolve "No".

The "Week 7 AP poll" refers to the AP Top 25 poll released in Week 7 of the 2026 regular season, expected on October 18, 2026. The preseason poll does not count.

A team ranked exactly 3th counts as "Yes"; a team ranked 4th or lower, receiving only "also receiving votes," or unranked counts as "No".

If the AP does not release a Week 7 poll for the 2026 season by October 18, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, resolution will be based on the first official in-season AP Top 25 poll published thereafter.

The primary resolution source will be the official Associated Press Top 25 college football poll (https://apnews.com/hub/ap-top-25-college-football-poll); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
